surah.personality_summary: Unique Qur'anic surah of 49 ayat revealed in Mecca, possessing its distinct thematic core, atmosphere, and rhetorical progression.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah At-Tur (The Mount) is the 52th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 49 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَٱلطُّورِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ وَالطُّورِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم والطور
ayahs.translation_saheeh: By the mount
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: By the mountain

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَكِتَٰبࣲ مَّسۡطُورࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَكِتَابٍ مَسْطُورٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وكتاب مسطور
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [by] a Book inscribed
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: by a Scripture inscribed

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فِي رَقࣲّ مَّنشُورࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: فِي رَقٍّ مَنْشُورٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: في رق منشور
ayahs.translation_saheeh: In parchment spread open
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: in unrolled parch-ment

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَٱلۡبَيۡتِ ٱلۡمَعۡمُورِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَالْبَيْتِ الْمَعْمُورِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: والبيت المعمور
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [by] the frequented House
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: by the much-visited House

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَٱلسَّقۡفِ ٱلۡمَرۡفُوعِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَالسَّقْفِ الْمَرْفُوعِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: والسقف المرفوع
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [by] the heaven raised high
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: by the raised canopy

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَٱلۡبَحۡرِ ٱلۡمَسۡجُورِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَالْبَحْرِ الْمَسْجُورِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: والبحر المسجور
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [by] the sea filled [with fire]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: by the ocean ever filled

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَاقِعٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ان عذاب ربك لواقع
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [Prophet], your Lord’s punishment is coming––

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: مَا لَهُ مِنْ دَافِعٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ما له من دافع
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Of it there is no preventer
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: it cannot be put off––

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: يَوۡمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوۡرࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: يَوْمَ تَمُورُ السَّمَاءُ مَوْرًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: يوم تمور السماء مورا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: on the Day when the sky sways back and forth

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلۡجِبَالُ سَيۡرࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَتَسِيرُ الْجِبَالُ سَيْرًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: وتسير الجبال سيرا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the mountains will pass on, departing
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and the mountains float away

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَوَيۡلࣱ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَوَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فويل يومئذ للمكذبين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Woe on that Day to those who deny the Truth

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ فِي خَوۡضࣲ يَلۡعَبُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: الَّذِينَ هُمْ فِي خَوْضٍ يَلْعَبُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: الذين هم في خوض يلعبون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: who amuse themselves with idle chatter

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: يَوۡمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
ayahs.arabic_simple: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: يوم يدعون الى نار جهنم دعا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: on that Day they will be thrust into the Fire of Hell

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: هَٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِي كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: هَٰذِهِ النَّارُ الَّتِي كُنْتُمْ بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: هذه النار التي كنتم بها تكذبون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: This is the Fire which you used to deny
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘This is the Fire you used to deny

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَفَسِحۡرٌ هَٰذَآ أَمۡ أَنتُمۡ لَا تُبۡصِرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَفَسِحْرٌ هَٰذَا أَمْ أَنْتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: افسحر هذا ام انتم لا تبصرون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then is this magic, or do you not see
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: So is this sorcery? Do you still not see it

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ٱصۡلَوۡهَا فَٱصۡبِرُوٓاْ أَوۡ لَا تَصۡبِرُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡۖ إِنَّمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: اصْلَوْهَا فَاصْبِرُوا أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوا سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: اصلوها فاصبروا او لا تصبروا سواء عليكم ۖ انما تجزون ما كنتم تعملون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Burn in it––it makes no difference whether you bear it patiently or not–– you are only being repaid for what you have done.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتࣲ وَنَعِيمࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَنَعِيمٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ان المتقين في جنات ونعيم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Those who were mindful of God are in Gardens and in bliss

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ وَوَقَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَاكِهِينَ بِمَا آتَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فاكهين بما اتاهم ربهم ووقاهم ربهم عذاب الجحيم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: rejoicing in their Lord’s gifts: He has saved them from the torment of the Blaze

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـَٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: كُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا هَنِيئًا بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: كلوا واشربوا هنيئا بما كنتم تعملون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘Eat and drink with healthy enjoyment as a reward for what you have done.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرࣲ مَّصۡفُوفَةࣲۖ وَزَوَّجۡنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: مُتَّكِئِينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مَصْفُوفَةٍ ۖ وَزَوَّجْنَاهُمْ بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: متكئين على سرر مصفوفة ۖ وزوجناهم بحور عين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They are comfortably seated on couches arranged in rows; We pair them with beautiful-eyed maidens

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَٱتَّبَعَتۡهُمۡ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَٰنٍ أَلۡحَقۡنَا بِهِمۡ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ وَمَآ أَلَتۡنَٰهُم مِّنۡ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَيۡءࣲۚ كُلُّ ٱمۡرِيِٕۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَاتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُمْ بِإِيمَانٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَا أَلَتْنَاهُمْ مِنْ عَمَلِهِمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ ۚ كُلُّ امْرِئٍ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: والذين امنوا واتبعتهم ذريتهم بايمان الحقنا بهم ذريتهم وما التناهم من عملهم من شيء ۚ كل امرئ بما كسب رهين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds. Every person, for what he earned, is retained
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We unite the believers with their offspring who followed them in faith–– We do not deny them any of the rewards for their deeds: each person is in pledge for his own deeds––

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَأَمۡدَدۡنَٰهُم بِفَٰكِهَةࣲ وَلَحۡمࣲ مِّمَّا يَشۡتَهُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَأَمْدَدْنَاهُمْ بِفَاكِهَةٍ وَلَحْمٍ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وامددناهم بفاكهة ولحم مما يشتهون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We provide them with any fruit or meat they desire

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأۡسࣰ ا لَّا لَغۡوࣱ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأۡثِيمࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: يَتَنَازَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا لَا لَغْوٌ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: يتنازعون فيها كاسا لا لغو فيها ولا تاثيم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They pass around a cup which does not lead to any idle talk or sin

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ۞وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ غِلۡمَانࣱ لَّهُمۡ كَأَنَّهُمۡ لُؤۡلُؤࣱ مَّكۡنُونࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌ لَهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌ مَكْنُونٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ۞ ويطوف عليهم غلمان لهم كانهم لؤلؤ مكنون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Devoted youths like hidden pearls wait on them

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَأَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضࣲ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: واقبل بعضهم على بعض يتساءلون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They turn to one another and say

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبۡلُ فِيٓ أَهۡلِنَا مُشۡفِقِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالُوا إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِي أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قالوا انا كنا قبل في اهلنا مشفقين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing Allah]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘When we were still with our families [on earth] we used to live in fear––

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَمَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَانَا عَذَابَ السَّمُومِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فمن الله علينا ووقانا عذاب السموم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: So Allah conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: God has been gracious to us and saved us from the torment of intense heat

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبۡلُ نَدۡعُوهُۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِنْ قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ ۖ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْبَرُّ الرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.arabic_clean: انا كنا من قبل ندعوه ۖ انه هو البر الرحيم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, we used to supplicate Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We used to pray to Him: He is the Good, the Merciful One.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَذَكِّرۡ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعۡمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنࣲ وَلَا مَجۡنُونٍ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَا أَنْتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فذكر فما انت بنعمت ربك بكاهن ولا مجنون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: So remind [O Muhammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: So [Prophet] remind [people]. By the grace of your Lord [Prophet], you are neither oracle nor madman

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرࣱ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيۡبَ ٱلۡمَنُونِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌ نَتَرَبَّصُ بِهِ رَيْبَ الْمَنُونِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ام يقولون شاعر نتربص به ريب المنون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: If they say, ‘He is only a poet: we shall await his fate,’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قُلۡ تَرَبَّصُواْ فَإِنِّي مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا فَإِنِّي مَعَكُمْ مِنَ الْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قل تربصوا فاني معكم من المتربصين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: say, ‘Wait if you wish; I too am waiting’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَمۡ تَأۡمُرُهُمۡ أَحۡلَٰمُهُم بِهَٰذَآۚ أَمۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمࣱ طَاغُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَامُهُمْ بِهَٰذَا ۚ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ام تامرهم احلامهم بهذا ۚ ام هم قوم طاغون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Or do their minds command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: does their reason really tell them to do this, or are they simply insolent people

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥۚ بَل لَّا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُ ۚ بَلْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ام يقولون تقوله ۚ بل لا يؤمنون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: If they say, ‘He has made it up himself’- they certainly do not believe

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَلۡيَأۡتُواْ بِحَدِيثࣲ مِّثۡلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُواْ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَلْيَأْتُوا بِحَدِيثٍ مِثْلِهِ إِنْ كَانُوا صَادِقِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فلياتوا بحديث مثله ان كانوا صادقين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: let them produce one like it, if what they say is true

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَمۡ خُلِقُواْ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ شَيۡءٍ أَمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰلِقُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَمْ خُلِقُوا مِنْ غَيْرِ شَيْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ الْخَالِقُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ام خلقوا من غير شيء ام هم الخالقون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Were they created without any agent? Were they the creators

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَمۡ خَلَقُواْ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَمْ خَلَقُوا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۚ بَلْ لَا يُوقِنُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ام خلقوا السماوات والارض ۚ بل لا يوقنون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Did they create the heavens and the earth? No! They do not have faith

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَمۡ عِندَهُمۡ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡمُصَۜيۡطِرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَمْ عِنْدَهُمْ خَزَائِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ الْمُصَيْطِرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ام عندهم خزائن ربك ام هم المصيطرون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Do they possess your Lord’s treasures or have control over them

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ سُلَّمࣱ يَسۡتَمِعُونَ فِيهِۖ فَلۡيَأۡتِ مُسۡتَمِعُهُم بِسُلۡطَٰنࣲ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُمْ بِسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ام لهم سلم يستمعون فيه ۖ فليات مستمعهم بسلطان مبين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Do they have a ladder to climb, in order to eavesdrop [on Heaven’s secrets]? Let their eavesdropper produce clear proof

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَمۡ لَهُ ٱلۡبَنَٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلۡبَنُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَمْ لَهُ الْبَنَاتُ وَلَكُمُ الْبَنُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ام له البنات ولكم البنون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Or has He daughters while you have sons
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Does God have daughters while you have sons

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ أَجۡرࣰ ا فَهُم مِّن مَّغۡرَمࣲ مُّثۡقَلُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَمْ تَسْأَلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُمْ مِنْ مَغْرَمٍ مُثْقَلُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ام تسالهم اجرا فهم من مغرم مثقلون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Do you [Prophet] demand a payment from them that would burden them with debt

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَمۡ عِندَهُمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبُ فَهُمۡ يَكۡتُبُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَمْ عِنْدَهُمُ الْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ام عندهم الغيب فهم يكتبون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Do they have [access to] the unseen? Could they write it down

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَمۡ يُرِيدُونَ كَيۡدࣰ اۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ هُمُ ٱلۡمَكِيدُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًا ۖ فَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا هُمُ الْمَكِيدُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ام يريدون كيدا ۖ فالذين كفروا هم المكيدون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Do they think they can ensnare you? It is the disbelievers who have been ensnared

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ إِلَٰهٌ غَيۡرُ ٱللَّهِۚ سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَٰهٌ غَيْرُ اللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ام لهم اله غير الله ۚ سبحان الله عما يشركون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Or have they a deity other than Allah? Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Do they really have another god besides God? God is far above anything they set alongside Him

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَإِن يَرَوۡاْ كِسۡفࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطࣰ ا يَقُولُواْ سَحَابࣱ مَّرۡكُومࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَإِنْ يَرَوْا كِسْفًا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ سَاقِطًا يَقُولُوا سَحَابٌ مَرْكُومٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وان يروا كسفا من السماء ساقطا يقولوا سحاب مركوم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling, they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Even if they saw a piece of heaven falling down on them, they would say, ‘Just a heap of clouds,’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَذَرۡهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوۡمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي فِيهِ يُصۡعَقُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَاقُوا يَوْمَهُمُ الَّذِي فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فذرهم حتى يلاقوا يومهم الذي فيه يصعقون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: so leave them, Prophet, until they face the Day when they will be thunderstruck

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُمۡ كَيۡدُهُمۡ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِي عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْئًا وَلَا هُمْ يُنْصَرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: يوم لا يغني عنهم كيدهم شيئا ولا هم ينصرون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: the Day when their snares will be of no use to them, when they will get no help

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ عَذَابࣰ ا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا عَذَابًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وان للذين ظلموا عذابا دون ذلك ولكن اكثرهم لا يعلمون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment before that, but most of them do not know
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Another punishment awaits the evildoers, though most of them do not realize it

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعۡيُنِنَاۖ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
ayahs.arabic_clean: واصبر لحكم ربك فانك باعيننا ۖ وسبح بحمد ربك حين تقوم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And be patient, [O Muhammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes. And exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord when you arise
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Wait patiently [Prophet] for your Lord’s judgement: you are under Our watchful eye. Celebrate the praise of your Lord when you rise

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَسَبِّحۡهُ وَإِدۡبَٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَمِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَارَ النُّجُومِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ومن الليل فسبحه وادبار النجوم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Glorify Him at night and at the fading of the stars
